notes.title: Patch Notes for Final version (I hope)
notes.content:
Hello there, Awakened!

You blink, and suddenly—boom!—a new update is here. We fixed some things, broke a few others (but then fixed those too), and added new ways for you to question reality. Here’s what’s new:

Subtitle Support

 Added AI-generated subtitles for German, Spanish, and Polish. Now even more people can misunderstand what’s going on!


What we broke and then fixed:

 TeleQ thought it was a cube but then decided to become a cuboid. We convinced it to behave.
 Mouse sensitivity was just a decorative option. Now it actually does something.
 Rebinding the "E" key for dialogues? Didn’t work. Now it does. You’re welcome.
 Font sizes were feeling artistic and decided to be different everywhere. We put an end to that.
 Melanius in Level 3 chose to stay forever. Now he knows when to leave.
 Some levels stayed in Czech when switching to English. We reminded them about globalization.
 Font settings were messed up. Now they are... less messed up.
 Level numbering was all over the place. We brought order to chaos.
 In the Czech version, the level select screen still said "Level1, Level2..." instead of proper translations. Fixed!
 The QR code was pointing to an outdated, incorrect video. Oops! Now it leads where it should.
 Doors in the Bonus Factory map were sliding into the wall. That's not how doors work. Fixed.
 Level 6 was missing cables for the doors. Now they exist. Magic!
 Melanius wasn’t talking to players if they loaded the game from the level selection. We made him more talkative.
 Melanius had no translation. Now he speaks in multiple languages (probably still judging you).
 If the player received a message from Melanius right before dying and a scheduled message played, the game froze. Now it doesn't.
 In Level 17, you could swap TeleQ through closed doors in the upper section—or just walk through them. That’s cheating. Fixed!
 In Level 18 and Level 17, Momo just stood there. Menacingly. Now he actually moves.
 Dialogue bug: If the player walked away from an NPC mid-conversation and immediately returned, only the voice played. Now you can actually read what they’re saying.


What we added because we care about you:

 New posters on the walls telling you what to do. Because who reads tutorials?
 A new QR code leading to a video about Melanius. Don’t say we didn’t warn you.
 Better graphics for Level 1 - Level 3. Now you can admire the view… or at least say, "Yeah, that looks better."
 AI-powered translations for German, Spanish, and Polish. Now more people can enjoy the madness!
 Steam Achievements! Because who doesn’t love meaningless virtual trophies?
 A brand-new outro. Yes, we finally gave the demo a proper ending.
 Momo was missing in all new maps. We found him. He’s back.
